t: 传统上是"古腾堡圣经"的出版日期,是第一本用可移动类型印刷的西方书籍.
te: Traditionally the date of publication of the Gutenberg Bible, the first Western book printed with movable type.
dz: 传统上是"古腾堡圣经"的出版日期,是第一本用可移动类型印刷的西方书籍.

t: 十三年战争:克奈波夫之战的开始.
te: the beginning of the Battle for Kneiphof.
dz: 十三年战争:克奈波夫之战的开始.
de: Thirteen Years' War: the beginning of the Battle for Kneiphof.

t: 效忠于国王詹姆斯二世的苏格兰皇家部队在阿金霍尔姆战役中击败了黑道格拉斯人的一支反叛军.
te: Scottish Royal forces loyal to King James II defeat a rebel army of the Black Douglases in the battle of Arkinholm.

t: 在第一次圣奥尔本斯战役中，约克公爵理查击败并俘虏了英格兰国王亨利六世。
te: At the First Battle of St Albans, Richard, Duke of York, defeats and captures King Henry VI of England.
dz: 玫瑰战争开始：在第一次圣奥尔本斯战役中，约克公爵理查击败并俘虏了英格兰国王亨利六世。
de: Start of the Wars of the Roses: At the First Battle of St Albans, Richard, Duke of York, defeats and captures King Henry VI of England.
